cards.stem: What term describes how delegates worked during the summer gathering?
cards.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787
cards.hint: Recall the openness of the sessions.

cards.stem: Where did the Federal Convention meet in the State House?
cards.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation.
cards.hint: Think of the Pennsylvania city named in the opening.

cards.stem: Which level of authority was debated for how much power to allow?
cards.quote: how much power to allow the central government
cards.hint: Focus on the balance between national and state levels.
